resources.string: Who this phone is. Each persona is its own key with its own contacts — the shop never learns your friends, and your friends never meet the shop. New relationships join whichever one you are wearing.
What this side of you is called — Shop, Market, Browsing.
Four is the limit: compartments only work when they fit on one hand.
A persona cannot be deleted — its contacts answer to its key alone. Stop using it and it goes quiet.
Showing %1$s\u2019s contacts — switch personas in the drawer for the rest.
